children: METHODE ELECTRONICS INC reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $265.4M, a 10.4% increase from the year-ago quarter, while the company recorded a net loss of $(11.4)M and diluted EPS of $(0.32), both slightly wider than the prior-year period — 10-Q Summary.
Revenue was $265.4M for the three months ended Aug 1, 2026, compared with $240.5M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 10.4%.
Net income was $(11.4)M for the three months ended Aug 1, 2026, versus $(10.3)M in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted earnings per share was $(0.32) for the three months ended Aug 1, 2026, versus $(0.29) in the prior-year quarter.
Net sales rose 10.4% year over year to $265.4M, driven by strength in the Industrial segment and growth in data center end markets.
Industrial sales increased 27%, while Interface sales declined 73% following a divestiture and program wind-down.

Demand for on- and off-highway lighting and data center solutions boosted volumes and recoveries, supporting improved automotive gross margin through better operations and lower inventory adjustments.
Company noted ongoing global tariff and geopolitical risks; mitigation actions include price negotiations and supply-chain optimization.
